findings.claim: `const log = console;` is deleted; any remaining `log.warn(...)`/`log.error(...)` call sites further down the file will now fail to compile (or resolve to a different `log` binding).
findings.rationale: The alias existed to be used elsewhere in the file. The hunk removes it without showing replacement call sites, so unless every usage was removed in another hunk this is a build break. Medium confidence — the rest of the file isn't visible.

findings.claim: `export interface JsonSchema` is removed from the module's public surface; consumers doing `import type { JsonSchema } from '.../generate'` will break.
findings.rationale: It was an exported type, so deleting it rather than aliasing (`export type JsonSchema = SchemaObject`) is a source-breaking API change. High confidence it is breaking; actual impact depends on whether it was re-exported from the package index.

findings.claim: Substituting `SchemaObject` for `JsonSchema` may drop shapes the generator relies on, notably `items?: JsonSchema | false`, `additionalProperties?: JsonSchema | boolean`, `$defs`, and `$schema`.
findings.rationale: The old local type explicitly allowed `items: false` (2020-12 tuple closing) and `$defs`. If `./types`' `SchemaObject` is a stricter OpenAPI 3.1 model, code emitting those keys will now need unsafe casts or will silently emit different documents. Moderate confidence without seeing `./types`.

findings.claim: `import * as fs from 'node:fs'` is added but no filesystem usage appears in this hunk.
findings.rationale: Likely used in a later hunk, but if not it's an unused import (fails `noUnusedLocals`/lint). Also worth confirming sync fs is intended over `node:fs/promises` given the async-ish generator. Low-to-medium confidence.

findings.claim: `Document`, `OperationObject`, `PathItemObject`, `PathsObject` are imported but unreferenced within this hunk.
findings.rationale: Presumably consumed later in the file, but a partial conversion would leave unused type imports. Flagged so all four are verified as used. Low confidence.
